# 金光明最勝王經疏

**ID:** T1788
**Volume:** T39
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 經疏部
**Byline:** 唐 慧沼撰
**Dynasty:** 唐
**Date:** 714
**Juans:** 6
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T1788

## Contributors
- 慧沼 (A001708)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

T1788 in six fascicles (Taishō; some witnesses give ten — CANWWW lists 10巻 reflecting the alternative division) is [慧沼](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E6%B2%BC)'s commentary on [義淨](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%BE%A9%E6%B7%A8)'s *[Jīnguāngmíng zuìshèngwáng jīng 金光明最勝王經](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0303)* (T665), the ten-fascicle long-form *Suvarṇaprabhāsa*. The work is the principal Yogācāra (Fǎxiàng / Cí'ēn 慈恩) commentary on the *Suvarṇaprabhāsa* in the Chinese tradition and stands in studied contrast to the Tiāntái commentarial line on [T663](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0301) ([T1783](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0304) / [T1785](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0306)).

**Abstract**

The Taishō opening identifies the parent text as 唐三藏法師義淨奉制譯 and the commentator as 翻經沙門慧沼撰. The dating bracket is constrained by the fact that [義淨](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%BE%A9%E6%B7%A8)'s [T665](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0303) was completed in 703, and the commentary was certainly written during 慧沼's late productive period at the Cí'ēnsì 慈恩寺 — typically dated 703–715. [慧沼](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E6%B2%BC) himself worked in [義淨](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%BE%A9%E6%B7%A8)'s translation bureau (a fact the colophon foregrounds with the title 翻經沙門), which gives the commentary an unusually direct relationship to the parent translation: this is exegesis from someone who had been *physically present* at the production of the source text.

Methodologically the commentary applies the Cí'ēn / Yogācāra apparatus — the *wǔzhòng wéishí guān* 五重唯識觀, the *bāshí* 八識 doctrine, the threefold Buddha-body (*tri-kāya*) — to the *Suvarṇaprabhāsa*, with particular attention to the chapters on the *fēnbié sānshēn* 分別三身 (Distinguishing the Three Bodies, T665 ch. 3) and *shòuliàng* 壽量, where Yogācāra has its strongest doctrinal interest. The commentary is significantly less concerned with the deity-cult and Jātaka chapters, which it generally glosses without elaborate allegorical machinery.

T1788 is the only extant Táng-period Yogācāra *Suvarṇaprabhāsa* commentary, and it transmitted an authoritative reading of [義淨](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%BE%A9%E6%B7%A8)'s text into the Heian Japanese reception — Hossō scholastic interpretation of the *Saishō-ō-kyō* depended heavily on it. The text's importance in modern East Asian scholarship has accordingly been considerable.

Related canonical texts: parent sūtra [KR6i0303](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0303) (金光明最勝王經 / T665).
